fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami-area rents and landlords, streetcar and traffic hazards, and proposed traffic-circle improvements; notes on Miami Life’s new office address; discussion of tourism and Miami–Bahamas travel and promotion; coverage of consumer-protection concerns including gasoline-pump measurement and weights-and-measures enforcement; brief local bulletins (Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Hollywood) and a report on Dade County justices of the peace resigning; society/column items and entertainment listings; and extensive promotional material regarding Florida oil prospects and related investment offerings.
